title: Field Services Standard: Disconnection Safeguards and Restoration under Medical and Life-Support Protections
content:
The disconnection safeguards attached to Medical and Life-Support Protections are set per protection: whether disconnection for nonpayment is barred while the certification is active, whether disconnected service must be restored when the protection is registered and within how many hours, whether the reconnection charge is waived, and how many personal contact attempts precede a disconnection.

## Bar and restoration

| Protection | No disconnection for nonpayment while the certification is active | Registering after a disconnection requires service to be restored | Hours within which service is restored | Restoration under the protection carries no reconnection charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Emergency Certificate | no | yes | 24 | yes |
| Standard Medical Baseline Allowance | no | no | 0 (not applicable) | no |
| Heating and Cooling Medical Baseline Allowance | no | no | 0 (not applicable) | no |
| Combined Medical Baseline Allowance | no | no | 0 (not applicable) | no |
| Life-Support Registration | yes | yes | 24 | yes |
| Critical Care Life-Support Registration | yes | yes | 4 | yes |

## Personal contact before disconnection

A contact attempt is a phone call or a premises visit.

| Protection | Personal contact attempts required before any disconnection of the agreement | Attempts required | Minimum hours between required attempts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Emergency Certificate | no | 0 | 0 |
| Standard Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | 1 | 24 |
| Heating and Cooling Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | 1 | 24 |
| Combined Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | 2 | 24 |
| Life-Support Registration | yes | 2 | 24 |
| Critical Care Life-Support Registration | yes | 3 | 24 |

## Standard notes

- The bar on disconnection for nonpayment is carried by the two life-support registrations only.
- Restoration and the waived reconnection charge go together: both read yes for the Medical Emergency Certificate and the two life-support registrations, and no for the three medical baseline allowances. The restoration window is 24 hours, except 4 hours for the Critical Care Life-Support Registration.
- The Medical Emergency Certificate is the one protection with no personal contact requirement. Where contact is required, the spacing is 24 hours under every protection.

### Hypothetical illustration

Under the Combined Medical Baseline Allowance two attempts are required at least 24 hours apart. A phone call at 09:00 on a Monday and a premises visit at 10:00 on the Tuesday are 25 hours apart and meet the spacing; a call at 09:00 and a visit at 16:00 on the same Monday are 7 hours apart and do not.
